clock_domains.name: clk_ref
clock_domains.description: Board reference. PLL input; CSR/host + cal/link FSM domain.

clock_domains.name: clk_rx_word
clock_domains.description: CDR-recovered word clock (line/16). Plesiochronous to clk_ref -> elastic FIFO in the digital datapath.

signals.name: rx_pdata
signals.meaning: Deserialized parallel data. Garbage until cdr_locked and while los is asserted.

signals.name: tia_offset_code
signals.meaning: TIA output-offset trim (photodiode dark-current compensation). Change only while cal_hold=1.

signals.name: la_gain_code
signals.meaning: Limiting-amp/VGA gain code from the calibration engine.

signals.name: cal_hold
signals.meaning: Freeze AFE-internal offset servo while digital rewrites trim codes.

signals.name: los
signals.meaning: Loss of signal (optical input below threshold). Forces the link FSM out of ACTIVE. Synchronized into clk_ref.

signals.name: cdr_locked
signals.meaning: CDR lock indication; gates word alignment start. Synchronized into clk_ref.

signals.name: rstn_por
signals.meaning: Chip POR, async assert; release synchronized per domain.

cdc_points.notes: Elastic FIFO in the digital datapath; absorbs the plesiochronous ppm offset.

reset_sequence.action: POR asserts asynchronously; all enables cleared, trim codes to defaults
POR release synchronized into each domain (2ff per domain)

power_sequence.action: Run TIA offset / LA gain calibration under cal_hold
Wait for signal + CDR lock, then start word alignment
power_sequence.wait_for: los deasserted AND cdr_locked (timeout 1 ms -> retry)
